entries.note: Official CIK results put Iotova first with 34.7% and a run-off; results.cik.bg not read, based on outlets citing CIK.

Government pre-announcement (22 Oct) lists energy cooperation only generally, and the post-visit release says only four non-gas memoranda were signed; no pre-noon 26 Oct statement of a gas document found (vlada.gov.cz read).
ČTK reports the five-party agreement was signed in the evening of 26 Oct (article stamped 17:58), after the 12:00 deadline; ceskenoviny.cz read.
ČTK says the Presidential Office confirmed the figure of 51 on 28 Oct; I found no earlier exact-number statement before 12:00 on 26 Oct (hrad.cz itself not read).
Majerová and Ševčík did abstain, but ČTK and other coverage report no SPD sanction in the window; absence found across several outlets, no primary SPD source read.
